story.en: The concluding Mass follows the fluvial landing, a gathering documented in 2022 and 2024. Its 18:00 replay start follows the illustrative 16:00–18:00 river window; the ninety-minute duration is illustrative. The owner marked the Basilica Loop as a car-free crowd precinct on 2026-10-07 and limited the crowd to the forecourt on 2026-10-08, as at the Cathedral. People fill the north park, the Centennial Globe lawn and Basilica Road, facing the Basilica; selected outdoor seating remains seated. The side parking and the loop behind the church stay clear.

sources.title: Naga Tourism: 2024 fluvial gathering
sources.note: Reports 1.5 million devotees and a concluding Basilica Pontifical Mass. The crowd layout and ninety-minute Mass are illustrative.

sources.title: Naga Tourism: updated 2026 fluvial schedule
sources.note: 2026 advisory: departure 21:00; estimated Mass start 23:00. Illustrative annual replay: river 16:00–18:00, Mass 18:00–19:30.

sources.title: City of Naga: 2022 fluvial procession and concluding Mass
sources.note: Documents the foot procession after the 14:00 Cathedral Mass and the concluding Mass; does not establish a 16:00 fluvial departure.

sources.title: OSM Basilica Loop and owner annotation
sources.note: OSM Basilica Loop curb; owner annotation, 2026-10-07: main loop and short northern pieces, offset four metres outward from the mapped six-metre carriageway centreline. On 2026-10-08 the owner limited the crowd to the forecourt: the boundary is cut along the south curb of Basilica Road (OSM way 23523456), in front of the facade.
